name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 29 - Am 34
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 29a. Calls on the Member States to implement protective measures for individuals unable to pay their rent, including prohibiting evictions for non-payment of rent when no decent alternative can be provided; calls for special protective measures to ensure that children are not evicted and for the establishment of a European winter eviction moratorium;
